attorneys: Delvaille H. Theard, pro se. Oscar H. Davis, then Acting Solicitor General, was on the motion, and Solicitor General Rankin was on a supplemental memorandum in support of the motion, for the United States.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 351 U. S. 961, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit. The motion of the Solicitor General to permit the Louisiana State Bar Association to present oral argument is denied. Leave to submit a brief is granted.
